title: はじめての学校 (Hajimete no Gakkou)
description: A young child named Yuuki experiences their very first day of elementary school — from the nervous morning routine, walking through the school gates, meeting a teacher and classmates, navigating lunch, recess, and clubs, all the way to the emotional walk home. A warm, detailed slice-of-life story capturing the excitement and anxiety of starting school in Japan.
author: オリジナル
